## ARTICLE XIII — PREPAYMENT

### Section 13.1 General; Relationship to the Note

The provisions of this **Article XIII** restate the prepayment terms applicable to the Loan and shall be read together with the prepayment provisions of the Note. Borrower shall not prepay all or any portion of the principal balance of the Loan except as expressly permitted by this **Article XIII**, and no prepayment shall relieve Borrower of any obligation to pay interest, fees, late charges, costs or other amounts then due. In the event of any inconsistency between this **Article XIII** and the Note as to the amount or calculation of any Prepayment Premium, the Note shall control.

### Section 13.2 Lockout Period

(a) The Loan may not be prepaid, in whole or in part, at any time during the period commencing on the Closing Date and ending on the last day of the twenty-fourth (24th) month following the Closing Date (that is, through April 15, 2027) (the "**Lockout Period**"). During the Lockout Period, no voluntary prepayment of principal shall be permitted, and Borrower shall not be entitled to tender any such prepayment.

(b) Any purported prepayment made during the Lockout Period shall not be accepted by Lender and shall not discharge any Obligation, and any such tender shall constitute an immediate Event of Default. Without limiting the foregoing, and to the extent Lender elects in its sole discretion to accept any amount tendered during the Lockout Period, Borrower shall pay, in addition to all other amounts due, a prepayment premium equal to the Yield Maintenance Premium computed as if the prepayment date were the last day of the Lockout Period, plus one percent (1.00%) of the principal amount so accepted.

(c) Notwithstanding clause (a), involuntary prepayments resulting from the application of casualty insurance proceeds or condemnation awards in accordance with **Sections 10.7** and **10.8**, and prepayments resulting from Lender's acceleration of the Obligations following an Event of Default, may be applied to the Obligations during the Lockout Period without payment of any Prepayment Premium.

### Section 13.3 Yield Maintenance Period

(a) **Permitted Prepayment.** During the period commencing on the day immediately following the last day of the Lockout Period and ending on the last day of the forty-eighth (48th) month following the Closing Date (that is, from April 16, 2027 through April 15, 2029) (the "**Yield Maintenance Period**"), Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole (but not in part) upon (i) not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Lender (which notice shall be irrevocable), and (ii) payment, on the date of prepayment, of the Yield Maintenance Premium, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, all other amounts then due and all costs and expenses (including any breakage, hedging or funding costs) incurred by Lender as a result of such prepayment.

(b) **Yield Maintenance Premium.** The "**Yield Maintenance Premium**" payable in connection with a prepayment during the Yield Maintenance Period shall equal the greater of:

> (i) one percent (1.00%) of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan as of the date of prepayment; and
>
> (ii) the present value of the excess, if any, of (A) the aggregate interest that would have accrued on the principal amount being prepaid at the Applicable Rate for the period from the date of prepayment through the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, assuming that such principal amount remained outstanding through the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period and that interest is payable monthly, over (B) the aggregate interest that would accrue on such principal amount for the same period at a rate per annum equal to the Treasury Rate plus fifty (50) basis points (0.50%), in each case discounted to present value as of the date of prepayment at a discount rate equal to the Treasury Rate, on a monthly basis, using a 30/360 day count convention.

In no event shall the amount determined under clause (ii) above be less than zero. The Yield Maintenance Premium shall be due and payable on the date of prepayment, and shall be in addition to all other amounts due under the Loan Documents. Partial prepayments shall not be permitted during the Yield Maintenance Period.

(c) **Treasury Rate.** "**Treasury Rate**" means the yield to maturity, as of the second (2nd) Business Day preceding the date of prepayment, of the United States Treasury security reported in Federal Reserve Statistical Release H.15 — Selected Interest Rates (or any successor publication) under the heading "Treasury Constant Maturities" having a maturity date closest to the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period; provided that if no published Treasury Constant Maturity has a maturity date within ninety (90) days of the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, the Treasury Rate shall be determined by linear interpolation between the yields of the two (2) published Treasury Constant Maturities having maturity dates nearest to (one above and one below) the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period.

(d) **Determination.** Lender shall deliver to Borrower, concurrently with or promptly after any demand for the Yield Maintenance Premium, a statement setting forth Lender's calculation of the Treasury Rate and the Yield Maintenance Premium in reasonable detail. Absent manifest error, Lender's calculation shall be conclusive and binding on Borrower. Borrower's obligation to pay the Yield Maintenance Premium shall not be affected by any change in the Applicable Rate, by any hedging transaction entered into by Lender, or by the source of the funds used to make the prepayment.

(e) **Characterization.** The parties acknowledge that the Yield Maintenance Premium is intended to compensate Lender for the loss of its bargained-for yield upon an early prepayment, is a reasonable estimate of Lender's probable loss, is not a penalty, and is a material inducement to Lender to make the Loan at the rate and on the terms set forth in the Loan Documents.

### Section 13.4 Open Prepayment Period

During the period commencing on the day immediately following the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period and ending on the Maturity Date (that is, from April 16, 2029 through April 15, 2030) (the "**Open Prepayment Period**"), Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole or in part, at any time and from time to time, without payment of any prepayment premium, penalty or yield maintenance amount, upon not less than fifteen (15) days' prior written notice to Lender.

### Section 13.5 Involuntary Prepayments

Any prepayment resulting from the application of casualty insurance proceeds or condemnation awards in accordance with **Sections 10.7** and **10.8**, and any payment resulting from Lender's acceleration of the Obligations, shall be applied to the Obligations at par without payment of any Prepayment Premium, and no notice period shall apply. Any amounts so applied shall be applied first to costs and expenses, then to accrued and unpaid interest, any late charges and Prepayment Premiums due, and then to principal.

### Section 13.6 No Reborrowing; No Defeasance

No amount prepaid or repaid may be reborrowed. Borrower shall not have any right to obtain a release of any portion of the Mortgaged Property from the lien of this Mortgage in exchange for substitute collateral or for the purchase of U.S. Treasury obligations or other defeasance collateral, and Lender shall have no obligation to accept any such substitution or defeasance.

## ARTICLE XIV — EVENTS OF DEFAULT; DEFAULT RATE; LATE CHARGES

### Section 14.1 Events of Default

Each of the following shall constitute an "**Event of Default**" under this Mortgage and the other Loan Documents:

(a) **Payment Default.** Failure by Borrower to pay when due any installment of principal, interest, or any other amount payable under the Note or this Mortgage, including any deposit required to be made into any Reserve Account, subject to the cure period set forth in **Section 14.3(a)**;

(b) **Covenant Default.** Failure by Borrower to observe or perform any covenant, agreement, obligation, term or condition contained in this Mortgage or any other Loan Document (other than those specifically addressed in another clause of this Section), continuing beyond the applicable cure period set forth in **Section 14.3(b)**;

(c) **Representation Default.** Any representation or warranty made by Borrower or Guarantor in this Mortgage, in any other Loan Document, or in any certificate, financial statement or report furnished to Lender, proves to have been materially false, misleading or inaccurate in any material respect when made or deemed made;

(d) **Insolvency.** The filing by or against Borrower or Guarantor of a petition in bankruptcy or for reorganization or the appointment of a receiver, trustee or custodian for any substantial part of the property or assets of Borrower or Guarantor, or any assignment for the benefit of creditors, or the commencement of any similar insolvency proceeding, in each case without dismissal within sixty (60) days (and, in the case of a voluntary filing or assignment, without any cure period);

(e) **Cross-Default.** A default by Borrower or Guarantor under any other indebtedness for borrowed money in an amount exceeding Two Hundred Fifty Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($250,000.00), individually or in the aggregate, which default is not cured within any applicable cure or grace period, or the occurrence of any event that permits the acceleration of any such indebtedness;

(f) **Cross-Default under Loan Documents.** A default by Borrower or Guarantor under the Note, the Guaranty, the Environmental Indemnity or any other Loan Document (after giving effect to any applicable notice and cure periods thereunder);

(g) **Insurance.** Failure by Borrower to maintain any insurance required under **Article X** or under any other Loan Document;

(h) **Completion.** Failure by Borrower to achieve Substantial Completion of the Renovation by the Substantial Completion Deadline in accordance with **Section 12.7**;

(i) **DSCR.** The DSCR falling below 1.25x for two (2) consecutive Test Periods following the commencement of DSCR testing in accordance with **Section 11.1**, without cure in accordance with **Section 14.3(d)**;

(j) **SPE Default.** Breach of any covenant set forth in **Article VIII**, or any failure of Borrower to maintain its status as a Single-Purpose Entity, or any amendment to the Operating Agreement or certificate of formation that impairs the SPE Provisions without Lender's consent;

(k) **Transfer Default.** Violation of the transfer restrictions set forth in **Section 9.2**;

(l) **Environmental Default.** Breach of any covenant set forth in **Section 7.1**, or the occurrence of any of the following with respect to the Property: (i) any violation of, or failure to comply with, the LUR; (ii) any penetration, removal, breach, compromise or disturbance of the Vapor Barrier without SCDHEC's prior written approval and Lender's prior written consent; (iii) any modification, termination, release or amendment of the LUR without Lender's prior written consent; (iv) any reopening by SCDHEC of Site ID No. SC-29403-0772 as a result of any act or omission of Borrower, any Tenant, the General Contractor or any of their respective agents or contractors; (v) the presence or release of any Hazardous Materials at, on, under or migrating from the Property in violation of Environmental Laws; or (vi) any failure to deliver the inspection report required by **Section 7.1(a)**;

(m) **Material Adverse Change.** A material adverse change in the financial condition, business, assets or operations of Borrower or Guarantor that, in Lender's reasonable judgment, materially impairs the ability of Borrower to perform its obligations under the Loan Documents or of Guarantor to perform its obligations under the Guaranty;

(n) **Judgments.** Entry of one or more final, non-appealable judgments against Borrower or Guarantor in an aggregate amount exceeding $250,000.00 that remains unsatisfied, unbonded or unstayed for thirty (30) days;

(o) **Loss of Priority.** This Mortgage ceases to constitute a valid first-priority lien on the Mortgaged Property, subject only to the Permitted Exceptions, or the Title Policy is cancelled, terminated or materially modified without Lender's consent;

(p) **Change of Use.** Any use of the Property in violation of **Section 9.4**; and

(q) **Other.** The occurrence of any other event or condition that constitutes an Event of Default as defined in the Note or in any other Loan Document.

### Section 14.2 Notice

Lender shall give Borrower written notice of any Event of Default described in **Section 14.1(b)** or **14.1(i)** for which a notice and cure period is provided in **Section 14.3**; provided that no notice shall be required, and no cure period shall apply, with respect to any Event of Default described in **Sections 14.1(a)** (following the expiration of the applicable cure period), **14.1(d)**, **14.1(j)**, **14.1(k)**, **14.1(l)**, or in the case of any Event of Default arising from a voluntary bankruptcy filing, any assignment for the benefit of creditors, or any transfer in violation of **Section 9.2**.

### Section 14.3 Cure Periods

The following cure periods shall apply to the Events of Default described in **Section 14.1**:

(a) **Payment Defaults.** Five (5) Business Days after the date on which payment was due.

(b) **Non-Monetary Defaults.** For any Event of Default described in **Section 14.1(b)** (other than SPE defaults, transfer restriction defaults, insurance defaults, environmental defaults and completion defaults, which are addressed in clauses (c), (f) and (g) below), thirty (30) calendar days after written notice from Lender to Borrower of such default; provided, however, that if the default is of a nature that it cannot reasonably be cured within thirty (30) calendar days, and Borrower has commenced and is diligently pursuing the cure thereof, the cure period shall be extended for an additional period not to exceed sixty (60) calendar days (for a total cure period not to exceed ninety (90) calendar days).

(c) **SPE and Transfer Defaults.** No cure period. Any breach of the covenants set forth in **Article VIII** or **Section 9.2** shall constitute an immediate Event of Default without notice or opportunity to cure.

(d) **DSCR Defaults.** No cure period, other than that the DSCR must remain below 1.25x for two (2) consecutive Test Periods before an Event of Default arises, as provided in **Section 11.1(c)**.

(e) **Completion Defaults.** Lender may, in its sole discretion and upon Borrower's written request delivered not less than thirty (30) days prior to the Substantial Completion Deadline, extend the Substantial Completion Deadline by up to ninety (90) days if Lender determines that (i) the delay is attributable solely to force majeure events, (ii) Borrower has funded all Renovation costs required to be funded by Borrower, and (iii) no other Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.

(f) **Insurance Defaults and Environmental Defaults.** No cure period, except that where the failure to maintain insurance results solely from the cancellation or non-renewal of a policy by the insurer, Borrower shall have ten (10) Business Days after written notice from Lender to obtain replacement coverage (which cure shall not be available more than once during the term of the Loan).

(g) **Other Defaults.** With respect to any Event of Default for which no cure period is expressly provided in this Section, no cure period shall apply.

### Section 14.4 Default Rate

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, the outstanding principal balance of the Loan shall bear interest at the Default Rate, being the Applicable Rate plus five percent (5.00%) per annum, accruing from the date of the Event of Default until such Event of Default is cured or the Loan is repaid in full, whichever first occurs, in each case as more particularly provided in the Note. Interest at the Default Rate shall be payable on demand and shall be secured by this Mortgage.

### Section 14.5 Late Charge

A late charge equal to five percent (5%) of any monthly installment of principal and/or interest shall be assessed on any payment not received by Lender within ten (10) calendar days after the applicable due date. The late charge is intended to compensate Lender for the additional administrative expense of processing late payments, is agreed by the parties to be a reasonable estimate of such expense, and shall not be deemed a penalty. The assessment of a late charge shall not cure any default, shall not preclude the imposition of the Default Rate, and shall not limit any other remedy of Lender.

### Section 14.6 Protective Advances

If Borrower fails to perform any covenant or obligation under the Loan Documents, or if Lender reasonably determines that it is necessary to protect the Mortgaged Property or its lien thereon, Lender may (but shall not be obligated to) make any payment, advance or expenditure on Borrower's behalf, including the payment of taxes, assessments, insurance premiums, liens, repairs, property preservation costs, and legal fees. All Protective Advances shall be secured by this Mortgage, shall bear interest at the Default Rate from the date advanced, and shall be due and payable on demand. Lender shall give Borrower prompt notice of any Protective Advance but shall not be required to obtain Borrower's consent thereto.

## ARTICLE XV — REMEDIES

### Section 15.1 Remedies upon Default

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, Lender may, at its election and in addition to all other rights and remedies available at law or in equity, exercise any one or more of the following remedies, concurrently or successively, without further notice or demand (except as expressly required by **Section 14.2** or by applicable law):

(a) declare the entire outstanding principal balance of the Loan, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, late charges, Prepayment Premiums, Protective Advances and all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, immediately due and payable (and, upon such declaration, all such amounts shall be immediately due and payable without further notice or demand);

(b) institute an action for the foreclosure of this Mortgage and the sale of the Mortgaged Property under the supervision of the court in accordance with the laws of the State of South Carolina;

(c) enforce the assignment of rents set forth in **Article IV**, including by giving notice to the Tenants to pay Rents directly to Lender;

(d) apply for the appointment of a receiver, trustee or custodian for the Mortgaged Property and the Rents, without notice, and Borrower hereby consents to such appointment and waives any requirement for a bond or for notice;

(e) exercise any and all rights and remedies of a secured party under the UCC, including the right to take possession of, and to sell, lease or otherwise dispose of, the Personal Property Collateral, subject to the notice requirements of the UCC;

(f) exercise any and all rights and remedies available under the Environmental Indemnity and the Guaranty, and proceed against Guarantor directly;

(g) cure any default on Borrower's behalf in accordance with **Section 14.6**;

(h) obtain specific performance of any covenant or agreement contained in the Loan Documents, or an injunction against any violation thereof; and

(i) exercise any other right or remedy available under the Loan Documents, at law, in equity, in bankruptcy or otherwise.

### Section 15.2 No Power of Sale

Lender and Borrower acknowledge that the State of South Carolina is a judicial-foreclosure state and that this Mortgage does not grant, and shall not be construed to grant, any power of sale or any right to sell the Mortgaged Property without judicial proceedings. Lender's remedies with respect to foreclosure of the lien of this Mortgage shall be pursued by an action in the courts of the State of South Carolina.

### Section 15.3 Cumulative Remedies; No Waiver

No right or remedy of Lender under the Loan Documents is intended to be exclusive of any other right or remedy, and each shall be cumulative and in addition to every other right or remedy given under the Loan Documents or now or hereafter existing at law, in equity, by statute or otherwise. No delay or omission by Lender in exercising any right or remedy shall impair any such right or remedy or constitute a waiver thereof, and no waiver by Lender of any Event of Default shall be effective unless in writing and signed by Lender, and then only to the extent expressly stated. A waiver of any Event of Default shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent Event of Default.

### Section 15.4 Application of Payments and Proceeds

All amounts received by Lender after an Event of Default, and all proceeds of foreclosure, sale, receivership, or the exercise of any remedy, shall be applied in the following order: first, to the costs and expenses of collection, enforcement, foreclosure and sale (including reasonable attorneys' fees, court costs, appraisal fees, receivership expenses and title costs); second, to Protective Advances; third, to accrued and unpaid interest (including interest at the Default Rate), late charges and any Prepayment Premium payable in accordance with **Section 13.5**; fourth, to the outstanding principal balance of the Loan; and fifth, to any other amounts due under the Loan Documents. Any surplus shall be paid to Borrower or to such other Person as may be entitled thereto by law.

### Section 15.5 Election of Remedies

Lender may proceed against the Mortgaged Property, against Guarantor, against any other collateral, or in any other manner permitted by the Loan Documents or applicable law, in such order and at such times as Lender may determine in its sole discretion, and shall not be required to exhaust any particular remedy, marshal assets, or proceed first against any particular Person or property, except to the extent required by applicable law. Nothing in this Section shall be construed to limit or expand any statutory or common-law election-of-remedies or one-satisfaction rule applicable to Lender's enforcement of the Loan Documents.

### Section 15.6 Borrower's Waivers

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Borrower waives: (a) any right to a marshalling of assets or a sale in inverse order of alienation; (b) any right to require Lender to proceed against any other Person or security before proceeding against the Mortgaged Property; (c) any defense based on the adequacy of the security or the availability of any other remedy; (d) any right of subrogation, contribution or reimbursement against any other Person until the Obligations have been paid and performed in full; (e) all rights of redemption from any sale of the Mortgaged Property, except as expressly provided by South Carolina law and not waivable; and (f) presentment, demand, notice of dishonor, protest and notice of protest with respect to the Note.

### Section 15.7 Attorneys' Fees and Enforcement Costs

If any Event of Default occurs, or if Lender becomes a party to any litigation, arbitration, bankruptcy or other proceeding relating to the Loan or the Mortgaged Property, Borrower shall pay all costs and expenses incurred by Lender in connection therewith, including reasonable attorneys' fees, expert witness fees, appraisal and inspection costs, title costs, court costs, and the costs of any appeal, together with interest thereon at the Default Rate. Borrower's obligation to pay such amounts shall be secured by this Mortgage and shall survive foreclosure and any bankruptcy proceeding.

### Section 15.8 Lender's Right to Possession

Upon an Event of Default, Lender may, to the extent permitted by applicable law and without limiting any other remedy, take possession of and operate the Mortgaged Property, and Borrower shall promptly surrender possession upon Lender's written demand. Borrower irrevocably appoints Lender as its attorney-in-fact, coupled with an interest, to take such actions as may be necessary to protect and preserve the Mortgaged Property following an Event of Default, including the management of the Property and the collection of Rents.

## ARTICLE XVI — NON-RECOURSE; EXCULPATION

### Section 16.1 Non-Recourse Obligations

The Obligations are structured as non-recourse obligations of Borrower, and nothing in this Mortgage shall be construed to create any personal liability of any Member, manager, officer or Affiliate of Borrower (other than Borrower itself) for the payment or performance of the Obligations. Recourse to Borrower and to Guarantor, and the exceptions to the non-recourse nature of the Loan, are governed exclusively by the Note, the Guaranty and the Environmental Indemnity, and in the event of any conflict between this Section and the Note, the Note shall control. Without limiting the foregoing, this Mortgage does not modify, limit or expand the carve-out events described in **Section 5.5(a)** of the Term Sheet, which include fraud or intentional misrepresentation; misapplication or misappropriation of rents, security deposits, insurance proceeds or condemnation awards; voluntary bankruptcy filings; environmental liability arising from the acts or omissions of Borrower, Guarantor or their agents; and violation of the transfer restrictions set forth in **Section 9.2**.

### Section 16.2 Limitation on Liability of Guarantor

Nothing in this Mortgage shall be deemed to impose on Guarantor any obligation beyond those expressly assumed by Guarantor in the Guaranty, the Environmental Indemnity and the Completion Guaranty, and Guarantor's execution of an acknowledgment of this Mortgage, if any, shall not expand Guarantor's obligations hereunder.

### Section 16.3 No Merger

The lien of this Mortgage shall not merge with any other interest, estate or lien held by Lender, whether by foreclosure, deed in lieu of foreclosure, acquisition of title or otherwise, it being the intent of the parties that Lender's rights and remedies under the Loan Documents continue in full force and effect until the Obligations are indefeasibly paid and performed in full, except to the extent Lender expressly elects otherwise in writing.

## ARTICLE XVII — MISCELLANEOUS

### Section 17.1 Notices

All notices, demands, consents, approvals and other communications under this Mortgage shall be in writing and shall be deemed duly given (a) when delivered by hand (with written confirmation of receipt), (b) one (1) Business Day after deposit with a nationally recognized overnight courier, (c) three (3) Business Days after deposit in the United States mail, certified or registered, return receipt requested, postage prepaid, or (d) when sent by electronic mail in portable document format, if sent during normal business hours of the recipient and otherwise on the next Business Day, provided that the sender does not receive an automated message indicating non-delivery. Notices shall be addressed as follows:

> **If to Lender:** Calverley Heritage Bank, 412 Whitaker Street, Savannah, Georgia 31401, Attention: Marcus Prideaux, Senior Vice President — Commercial Real Estate Lending, Email: mprideaux@coastalheritagebank.com; with a copy to Fielding, Ashworth & Cole LLP, Attention: Catherine Ashworth, Partner, Email: (as designated by Lender in writing).
>
> **If to Borrower:** Palmetto Gateway Partners LLC, 88 Broad Street, Suite 200, Charleston, South Carolina 29401, Attention: Neil Ashford Graydon, Managing Member of Graydon Development Group LLC; with a copy to Cartwright & Lyons LLP, Attention: (as designated by Borrower in writing).
>
> **If to Guarantor:** Neil Ashford Graydon, 14 Church Street, Charleston, South Carolina 29401.

Any party may change its notice address by written notice given in accordance with this Section.

### Section 17.2 Governing Law; Venue

This Mortgage shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of South Carolina, without regard to principles of conflicts of law that would require the application of the laws of another jurisdiction. Any litigation arising out of or relating to this Mortgage or the other Loan Documents shall be brought in the courts of the State of South Carolina, County of Charleston, or in the United States District Court for the District of South Carolina, Charleston Division, and each party consents to the personal jurisdiction and venue of such courts.

### Section 17.3 Waiver of Jury Trial

**BORROWER AND LENDER EACH KNOWINGLY, VOLUNTARILY AND INTENTIONALLY WAIVE ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION, PROCEEDING OR COUNTERCLAIM ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS MORTGAGE, THE OTHER LOAN DOCUMENTS, THE LOAN OR THE PROPERTY.** Borrower certifies that this waiver is a material inducement to Lender's making of the Loan and that it has had the opportunity to consult with counsel regarding this waiver.

### Section 17.4 Usury Savings

Notwithstanding any other provision of the Loan Documents, no provision of the Loan Documents shall require the payment or permit the collection of interest or other charges in excess of the maximum amount permitted by applicable law. If any amount in excess of such maximum is paid or collected, such excess shall be applied to reduce the principal balance of the Loan (or, if the principal balance has been paid in full, refunded to Borrower), and the effective rate of interest shall be automatically reduced to the maximum lawful rate.

### Section 17.5 Severability

If any provision of this Mortgage is held to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable in any respect, such invalidity, illegality or unenforceability shall not affect any other provision, and this Mortgage shall be construed as if such provision had never been contained herein, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

### Section 17.6 Successors and Assigns; No Assignment by Borrower

This Mortgage shall be binding upon and shall inure to the benefit of Borrower, Lender and their respective successors and permitted assigns. Borrower may not assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations under this Mortgage except in compliance with **Section 9.2**, and any purported assignment in violation thereof shall be void. Lender may assign or participate its interest in the Loan and this Mortgage without Borrower's consent, and Borrower shall reasonably cooperate with any such assignment or participation, including by providing such information and estoppel certificates as Lender may reasonably request.

### Section 17.7 Entire Agreement; Amendment

The Loan Documents, together with the Term Sheet (to the extent not superseded by the Loan Documents), constitute the entire agreement among the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersede all prior agreements, understandings and negotiations, whether written or oral. In the event of any conflict between the terms of the Term Sheet and the terms of any Loan Document, the terms of the Loan Document shall control. No amendment, modification or waiver of any provision of this Mortgage shall be effective unless in writing and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought.

### Section 17.8 Estoppel Certificates

Within ten (10) Business Days after Lender's written request, Borrower shall deliver to Lender, or to any prospective purchaser or assignee designated by Lender, a certificate certifying (a) the outstanding principal balance of the Loan and the amount of accrued and unpaid interest, (b) whether any Event of Default exists, (c) the absence of any offsets, defenses or claims against Lender, and (d) such other matters as Lender may reasonably request.

### Section 17.9 Time of the Essence

Time is of the essence with respect to each obligation of Borrower under this Mortgage and the other Loan Documents.

### Section 17.10 No Partnership or Joint Venture

Nothing in this Mortgage shall be deemed to create a partnership, joint venture or fiduciary relationship between Lender and Borrower, or to make Lender a partner or joint venturer in Borrower's business. The relationship of Lender and Borrower is that of creditor and debtor (and mortgagee and mortgagor) only.

### Section 17.11 Recording; Expenses; Documentary Stamps

Borrower shall pay all costs and expenses of recording this Mortgage and all financing statements and amendments in the RMC Office and with the South Carolina Secretary of State, including all documentary stamp taxes, recording fees, title insurance premiums and endorsements, and all other costs of the Loan described in **Section 13.2** of the Term Sheet. The documentary stamp tax payable on this Mortgage, computed at the rate of $1.85 per $500.00 of indebtedness secured hereby on the amount of $14,750,000.00, is $54,575.00, which shall be paid at or prior to recording. Borrower shall pay such additional documentary stamp taxes as may be required in connection with any future advance or increase in the indebtedness secured hereby. Borrower's obligations under this Section shall survive the recording of this Mortgage and shall be secured hereby.

### Section 17.12 Counterparts; Electronic Signatures

This Mortgage may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart by facsimile or electronic mail (including in portable document format) shall have the same force and effect as delivery of an originally executed counterpart. Any electronic signature complying with the South Carolina Uniform Electronic Transactions Act, S.C. Code Ann. § 26-6-10 *et seq.*, shall be deemed a valid original signature; provided that, for purposes of recording, an original or notarized counterpart shall be delivered as required.

### Section 17.13 Headings; Construction

The headings in this Mortgage are for convenience of reference only and shall not affect the interpretation of any provision. The parties acknowledge that each has been represented by counsel of its choosing in the negotiation and preparation of this Mortgage.

### Section 17.14 Acknowledgment of No Fiduciary Duty

Lender's relationship to Borrower is solely that of a lender and mortgagee. Lender has no fiduciary or other special relationship with Borrower, and Borrower acknowledges that Lender has not provided any legal, tax, accounting or investment advice to Borrower in connection with the Loan.

### Section 17.15 Survival

All representations, warranties, covenants and indemnities contained in this Mortgage shall survive the closing of the Loan, the recording of this Mortgage and, except to the extent fully performed, the repayment of the Loan.

## ARTICLE XIII — PREPAYMENT

### Section 13.1 General; Relationship to the Note

The provisions of this **Article XIII** restate the prepayment terms applicable to the Loan and shall be read together with the prepayment provisions of the Note. Borrower shall not prepay all or any portion of the principal balance of the Loan except as expressly permitted by this **Article XIII**, and no prepayment shall relieve Borrower of any obligation to pay interest, fees, late charges, costs or other amounts then due. In the event of any inconsistency between this **Article XIII** and the Note as to the amount or calculation of any Prepayment Premium, the Note shall control.

### Section 13.2 Lockout Period

(a) The Loan may not be prepaid, in whole or in part, at any time during the period commencing on the Closing Date and ending on the last day of the twenty-fourth (24th) month following the Closing Date (that is, through April 15, 2027) (the "**Lockout Period**"). During the Lockout Period, no voluntary prepayment of principal shall be permitted, and Borrower shall not be entitled to tender any such prepayment.

(b) Any purported prepayment made during the Lockout Period shall not be accepted by Lender and shall not discharge any Obligation, and any such tender shall constitute an immediate Event of Default. Without limiting the foregoing, and to the extent Lender elects in its sole discretion to accept any amount tendered during the Lockout Period, Borrower shall pay, in addition to all other amounts due, a prepayment premium equal to the Yield Maintenance Premium computed as if the prepayment date were the last day of the Lockout Period, plus one percent (1.00%) of the principal amount so accepted.

(c) Notwithstanding clause (a), involuntary prepayments resulting from the application of casualty insurance proceeds or condemnation awards in accordance with **Sections 10.7** and **10.8**, and prepayments resulting from Lender's acceleration of the Obligations following an Event of Default, may be applied to the Obligations during the Lockout Period without payment of any Prepayment Premium.

### Section 13.3 Yield Maintenance Period

(a) **Permitted Prepayment.** During the period commencing on the day immediately following the last day of the Lockout Period and ending on the last day of the forty-eighth (48th) month following the Closing Date (that is, from April 16, 2027 through April 15, 2029) (the "**Yield Maintenance Period**"), Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole (but not in part) upon (i) not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Lender (which notice shall be irrevocable), and (ii) payment, on the date of prepayment, of the Yield Maintenance Premium, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, all other amounts then due and all costs and expenses (including any breakage, hedging or funding costs) incurred by Lender as a result of such prepayment.

(b) **Yield Maintenance Premium.** The "**Yield Maintenance Premium**" payable in connection with a prepayment during the Yield Maintenance Period shall equal the greater of:

> (i) one percent (1.00%) of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan as of the date of prepayment; and
>
> (ii) the present value of the excess, if any, of (A) the aggregate interest that would have accrued on the principal amount being prepaid at the Applicable Rate for the period from the date of prepayment through the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, assuming that such principal amount remained outstanding through the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period and that interest is payable monthly, over (B) the aggregate interest that would accrue on such principal amount for the same period at a rate per annum equal to the Treasury Rate plus fifty (50) basis points (0.50%), in each case discounted to present value as of the date of prepayment at a discount rate equal to the Treasury Rate, on a monthly basis, using a 30/360 day count convention.

In no event shall the amount determined under clause (ii) above be less than zero. The Yield Maintenance Premium shall be due and payable on the date of prepayment, and shall be in addition to all other amounts due under the Loan Documents. Partial prepayments shall not be permitted during the Yield Maintenance Period.

(c) **Treasury Rate.** "**Treasury Rate**" means the yield to maturity, as of the second (2nd) Business Day preceding the date of prepayment, of the United States Treasury security reported in Federal Reserve Statistical Release H.15 — Selected Interest Rates (or any successor publication) under the heading "Treasury Constant Maturities" having a maturity date closest to the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period; provided that if no published Treasury Constant Maturity has a maturity date within ninety (90) days of the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, the Treasury Rate shall be determined by linear interpolation between the yields of the two (2) published Treasury Constant Maturities having maturity dates nearest to (one above and one below) the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period.

(d) **Determination.** Lender shall deliver to Borrower, concurrently with or promptly after any demand for the Yield Maintenance Premium, a statement setting forth Lender's calculation of the Treasury Rate and the Yield Maintenance Premium in reasonable detail. Absent manifest error, Lender's calculation shall be conclusive and binding on Borrower. Borrower's obligation to pay the Yield Maintenance Premium shall not be affected by any change in the Applicable Rate, by any hedging transaction entered into by Lender, or by the source of the funds used to make the prepayment.

(e) **Characterization.** The parties acknowledge that the Yield Maintenance Premium is intended to compensate Lender for the loss of its bargained-for yield upon an early prepayment, is a reasonable estimate of Lender's probable loss, is not a penalty, and is a material inducement to Lender to make the Loan at the rate and on the terms set forth in the Loan Documents.

### Section 13.4 Open Prepayment Period

During the period commencing on the day immediately following the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period and ending on the Maturity Date (that is, from April 16, 2029 through April 15, 2030) (the "**Open Prepayment Period**"), Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole or in part, at any time and from time to time, without payment of any prepayment premium, penalty or yield maintenance amount, upon not less than fifteen (15) days' prior written notice to Lender.

### Section 13.5 Involuntary Prepayments

Any prepayment resulting from the application of casualty insurance proceeds or condemnation awards in accordance with **Sections 10.7** and **10.8**, and any payment resulting from Lender's acceleration of the Obligations, shall be applied to the Obligations at par without payment of any Prepayment Premium, and no notice period shall apply. Any amounts so applied shall be applied first to costs and expenses, then to accrued and unpaid interest, any late charges and Prepayment Premiums due, and then to principal.

### Section 13.6 No Reborrowing; No Defeasance

No amount prepaid or repaid may be reborrowed. Borrower shall not have any right to obtain a release of any portion of the Mortgaged Property from the lien of this Mortgage in exchange for substitute collateral or for the purchase of U.S. Treasury obligations or other defeasance collateral, and Lender shall have no obligation to accept any such substitution or defeasance.

## ARTICLE XIV — EVENTS OF DEFAULT; DEFAULT RATE; LATE CHARGES

### Section 14.1 Events of Default

Each of the following shall constitute an "**Event of Default**" under this Mortgage and the other Loan Documents:

(a) **Payment Default.** Failure by Borrower to pay when due any installment of principal, interest, or any other amount payable under the Note or this Mortgage, including any deposit required to be made into any Reserve Account, subject to the cure period set forth in **Section 14.3(a)**;

(b) **Covenant Default.** Failure by Borrower to observe or perform any covenant, agreement, obligation, term or condition contained in this Mortgage or any other Loan Document (other than those specifically addressed in another clause of this Section), continuing beyond the applicable cure period set forth in **Section 14.3(b)**;

(c) **Representation Default.** Any representation or warranty made by Borrower or Guarantor in this Mortgage, in any other Loan Document, or in any certificate, financial statement or report furnished to Lender, proves to have been materially false, misleading or inaccurate in any material respect when made or deemed made;

(d) **Insolvency.** The filing by or against Borrower or Guarantor of a petition in bankruptcy or for reorganization or the appointment of a receiver, trustee or custodian for any substantial part of the property or assets of Borrower or Guarantor, or any assignment for the benefit of creditors, or the commencement of any similar insolvency proceeding, in each case without dismissal within sixty (60) days (and, in the case of a voluntary filing or assignment, without any cure period);

(e) **Cross-Default.** A default by Borrower or Guarantor under any other indebtedness for borrowed money in an amount exceeding Two Hundred Fifty Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($250,000.00), individually or in the aggregate, which default is not cured within any applicable cure or grace period, or the occurrence of any event that permits the acceleration of any such indebtedness;

(f) **Cross-Default under Loan Documents.** A default by Borrower or Guarantor under the Note, the Guaranty, the Environmental Indemnity or any other Loan Document (after giving effect to any applicable notice and cure periods thereunder);

(g) **Insurance.** Failure by Borrower to maintain any insurance required under **Article X** or under any other Loan Document;

(h) **Completion.** Failure by Borrower to achieve Substantial Completion of the Renovation by the Substantial Completion Deadline in accordance with **Section 12.7**;

(i) **DSCR.** The DSCR falling below 1.25x for two (2) consecutive Test Periods following the commencement of DSCR testing in accordance with **Section 11.1**, without cure in accordance with **Section 14.3(d)**;

(j) **SPE Default.** Breach of any covenant set forth in **Article VIII**, or any failure of Borrower to maintain its status as a Single-Purpose Entity, or any amendment to the Operating Agreement or certificate of formation that impairs the SPE Provisions without Lender's consent;

(k) **Transfer Default.** Violation of the transfer restrictions set forth in **Section 9.2**;

(l) **Environmental Default.** Breach of any covenant set forth in **Section 7.1**, or the occurrence of any of the following with respect to the Property: (i) any violation of, or failure to comply with, the LUR; (ii) any penetration, removal, breach, compromise or disturbance of the Vapor Barrier without SCDHEC's prior written approval and Lender's prior written consent; (iii) any modification, termination, release or amendment of the LUR without Lender's prior written consent; (iv) any reopening by SCDHEC of Site ID No. SC-29403-0772 as a result of any act or omission of Borrower, any Tenant, the General Contractor or any of their respective agents or contractors; (v) the presence or release of any Hazardous Materials at, on, under or migrating from the Property in violation of Environmental Laws; or (vi) any failure to deliver the inspection report required by **Section 7.1(a)**;

(m) **Material Adverse Change.** A material adverse change in the financial condition, business, assets or operations of Borrower or Guarantor that, in Lender's reasonable judgment, materially impairs the ability of Borrower to perform its obligations under the Loan Documents or of Guarantor to perform its obligations under the Guaranty;

(n) **Judgments.** Entry of one or more final, non-appealable judgments against Borrower or Guarantor in an aggregate amount exceeding $250,000.00 that remains unsatisfied, unbonded or unstayed for thirty (30) days;

(o) **Loss of Priority.** This Mortgage ceases to constitute a valid first-priority lien on the Mortgaged Property, subject only to the Permitted Exceptions, or the Title Policy is cancelled, terminated or materially modified without Lender's consent;

(p) **Change of Use.** Any use of the Property in violation of **Section 9.4**; and

(q) **Other.** The occurrence of any other event or condition that constitutes an Event of Default as defined in the Note or in any other Loan Document.

### Section 14.2 Notice

Lender shall give Borrower written notice of any Event of Default described in **Section 14.1(b)** or **14.1(i)** for which a notice and cure period is provided in **Section 14.3**; provided that no notice shall be required, and no cure period shall apply, with respect to any Event of Default described in **Sections 14.1(a)** (following the expiration of the applicable cure period), **14.1(d)**, **14.1(j)**, **14.1(k)**, **14.1(l)**, or in the case of any Event of Default arising from a voluntary bankruptcy filing, any assignment for the benefit of creditors, or any transfer in violation of **Section 9.2**.

### Section 14.3 Cure Periods

The following cure periods shall apply to the Events of Default described in **Section 14.1**:

(a) **Payment Defaults.** Five (5) Business Days after the date on which payment was due.

(b) **Non-Monetary Defaults.** For any Event of Default described in **Section 14.1(b)** (other than SPE defaults, transfer restriction defaults, insurance defaults, environmental defaults and completion defaults, which are addressed in clauses (c), (f) and (g) below), thirty (30) calendar days after written notice from Lender to Borrower of such default; provided, however, that if the default is of a nature that it cannot reasonably be cured within thirty (30) calendar days, and Borrower has commenced and is diligently pursuing the cure thereof, the cure period shall be extended for an additional period not to exceed sixty (60) calendar days (for a total cure period not to exceed ninety (90) calendar days).

(c) **SPE and Transfer Defaults.** No cure period. Any breach of the covenants set forth in **Article VIII** or **Section 9.2** shall constitute an immediate Event of Default without notice or opportunity to cure.

(d) **DSCR Defaults.** No cure period, other than that the DSCR must remain below 1.25x for two (2) consecutive Test Periods before an Event of Default arises, as provided in **Section 11.1(c)**.

(e) **Completion Defaults.** Lender may, in its sole discretion and upon Borrower's written request delivered not less than thirty (30) days prior to the Substantial Completion Deadline, extend the Substantial Completion Deadline by up to ninety (90) days if Lender determines that (i) the delay is attributable solely to force majeure events, (ii) Borrower has funded all Renovation costs required to be funded by Borrower, and (iii) no other Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.

(f) **Insurance Defaults and Environmental Defaults.** No cure period, except that where the failure to maintain insurance results solely from the cancellation or non-renewal of a policy by the insurer, Borrower shall have ten (10) Business Days after written notice from Lender to obtain replacement coverage (which cure shall not be available more than once during the term of the Loan).

(g) **Other Defaults.** With respect to any Event of Default for which no cure period is expressly provided in this Section, no cure period shall apply.

### Section 14.4 Default Rate

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, the outstanding principal balance of the Loan shall bear interest at the Default Rate, being the Applicable Rate plus five percent (5.00%) per annum, accruing from the date of the Event of Default until such Event of Default is cured or the Loan is repaid in full, whichever first occurs, in each case as more particularly provided in the Note. Interest at the Default Rate shall be payable on demand and shall be secured by this Mortgage.

### Section 14.5 Late Charge

A late charge equal to five percent (5%) of any monthly installment of principal and/or interest shall be assessed on any payment not received by Lender within ten (10) calendar days after the applicable due date. The late charge is intended to compensate Lender for the additional administrative expense of processing late payments, is agreed by the parties to be a reasonable estimate of such expense, and shall not be deemed a penalty. The assessment of a late charge shall not cure any default, shall not preclude the imposition of the Default Rate, and shall not limit any other remedy of Lender.

### Section 14.6 Protective Advances

If Borrower fails to perform any covenant or obligation under the Loan Documents, or if Lender reasonably determines that it is necessary to protect the Mortgaged Property or its lien thereon, Lender may (but shall not be obligated to) make any payment, advance or expenditure on Borrower's behalf, including the payment of taxes, assessments, insurance premiums, liens, repairs, property preservation costs, and legal fees. All Protective Advances shall be secured by this Mortgage, shall bear interest at the Default Rate from the date advanced, and shall be due and payable on demand. Lender shall give Borrower prompt notice of any Protective Advance but shall not be required to obtain Borrower's consent thereto.

## ARTICLE XV — REMEDIES

### Section 15.1 Remedies upon Default

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, Lender may, at its election and in addition to all other rights and remedies available at law or in equity, exercise any one or more of the following remedies, concurrently or successively, without further notice or demand (except as expressly required by **Section 14.2** or by applicable law):

(a) declare the entire outstanding principal balance of the Loan, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, late charges, Prepayment Premiums, Protective Advances and all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, immediately due and payable (and, upon such declaration, all such amounts shall be immediately due and payable without further notice or demand);

(b) institute an action for the foreclosure of this Mortgage and the sale of the Mortgaged Property under the supervision of the court in accordance with the laws of the State of South Carolina;

(c) enforce the assignment of rents set forth in **Article IV**, including by giving notice to the Tenants to pay Rents directly to Lender;

(d) apply for the appointment of a receiver, trustee or custodian for the Mortgaged Property and the Rents, without notice, and Borrower hereby consents to such appointment and waives any requirement for a bond or for notice;

(e) exercise any and all rights and remedies of a secured party under the UCC, including the right to take possession of, and to sell, lease or otherwise dispose of, the Personal Property Collateral, subject to the notice requirements of the UCC;

(f) exercise any and all rights and remedies available under the Environmental Indemnity and the Guaranty, and proceed against Guarantor directly;

(g) cure any default on Borrower's behalf in accordance with **Section 14.6**;

(h) obtain specific performance of any covenant or agreement contained in the Loan Documents, or an injunction against any violation thereof; and

(i) exercise any other right or remedy available under the Loan Documents, at law, in equity, in bankruptcy or otherwise.

### Section 15.2 No Power of Sale

Lender and Borrower acknowledge that the State of South Carolina is a judicial-foreclosure state and that this Mortgage does not grant, and shall not be construed to grant, any power of sale or any right to sell the Mortgaged Property without judicial proceedings. Lender's remedies with respect to foreclosure of the lien of this Mortgage shall be pursued by an action in the courts of the State of South Carolina.

### Section 15.3 Cumulative Remedies; No Waiver

No right or remedy of Lender under the Loan Documents is intended to be exclusive of any other right or remedy, and each shall be cumulative and in addition to every other right or remedy given under the Loan Documents or now or hereafter existing at law, in equity, by statute or otherwise. No delay or omission by Lender in exercising any right or remedy shall impair any such right or remedy or constitute a waiver thereof, and no waiver by Lender of any Event of Default shall be effective unless in writing and signed by Lender, and then only to the extent expressly stated. A waiver of any Event of Default shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent Event of Default.

### Section 15.4 Application of Payments and Proceeds

All amounts received by Lender after an Event of Default, and all proceeds of foreclosure, sale, receivership, or the exercise of any remedy, shall be applied in the following order: first, to the costs and expenses of collection, enforcement, foreclosure and sale (including reasonable attorneys' fees, court costs, appraisal fees, receivership expenses and title costs); second, to Protective Advances; third, to accrued and unpaid interest (including interest at the Default Rate), late charges and any Prepayment Premium payable in accordance with **Section 13.5**; fourth, to the outstanding principal balance of the Loan; and fifth, to any other amounts due under the Loan Documents. Any surplus shall be paid to Borrower or to such other Person as may be entitled thereto by law.

### Section 15.5 Election of Remedies

Lender may proceed against the Mortgaged Property, against Guarantor, against any other collateral, or in any other manner permitted by the Loan Documents or applicable law, in such order and at such times as Lender may determine in its sole discretion, and shall not be required to exhaust any particular remedy, marshal assets, or proceed first against any particular Person or property, except to the extent required by applicable law. Nothing in this Section shall be construed to limit or expand any statutory or common-law election-of-remedies or one-satisfaction rule applicable to Lender's enforcement of the Loan Documents.

### Section 15.6 Borrower's Waivers

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Borrower waives: (a) any right to a marshalling of assets or a sale in inverse order of alienation; (b) any right to require Lender to proceed against any other Person or security before proceeding against the Mortgaged Property; (c) any defense based on the adequacy of the security or the availability of any other remedy; (d) any right of subrogation, contribution or reimbursement against any other Person until the Obligations have been paid and performed in full; (e) all rights of redemption from any sale of the Mortgaged Property, except as expressly provided by South Carolina law and not waivable; and (f) presentment, demand, notice of dishonor, protest and notice of protest with respect to the Note.

### Section 15.7 Attorneys' Fees and Enforcement Costs

If any Event of Default occurs, or if Lender becomes a party to any litigation, arbitration, bankruptcy or other proceeding relating to the Loan or the Mortgaged Property, Borrower shall pay all costs and expenses incurred by Lender in connection therewith, including reasonable attorneys' fees, expert witness fees, appraisal and inspection costs, title costs, court costs, and the costs of any appeal, together with interest thereon at the Default Rate. Borrower's obligation to pay such amounts shall be secured by this Mortgage and shall survive foreclosure and any bankruptcy proceeding.

### Section 15.8 Lender's Right to Possession

Upon an Event of Default, Lender may, to the extent permitted by applicable law and without limiting any other remedy, take possession of and operate the Mortgaged Property, and Borrower shall promptly surrender possession upon Lender's written demand. Borrower irrevocably appoints Lender as its attorney-in-fact, coupled with an interest, to take such actions as may be necessary to protect and preserve the Mortgaged Property following an Event of Default, including the management of the Property and the collection of Rents.

## ARTICLE XVI — NON-RECOURSE; EXCULPATION

### Section 16.1 Non-Recourse Obligations

The Obligations are structured as non-recourse obligations of Borrower, and nothing in this Mortgage shall be construed to create any personal liability of any Member, manager, officer or Affiliate of Borrower (other than Borrower itself) for the payment or performance of the Obligations. Recourse to Borrower and to Guarantor, and the exceptions to the non-recourse nature of the Loan, are governed exclusively by the Note, the Guaranty and the Environmental Indemnity, and in the event of any conflict between this Section and the Note, the Note shall control. Without limiting the foregoing, this Mortgage does not modify, limit or expand the carve-out events described in **Section 5.5(a)** of the Term Sheet, which include fraud or intentional misrepresentation; misapplication or misappropriation of rents, security deposits, insurance proceeds or condemnation awards; voluntary bankruptcy filings; environmental liability arising from the acts or omissions of Borrower, Guarantor or their agents; and violation of the transfer restrictions set forth in **Section 9.2**.

### Section 16.2 Limitation on Liability of Guarantor

Nothing in this Mortgage shall be deemed to impose on Guarantor any obligation beyond those expressly assumed by Guarantor in the Guaranty, the Environmental Indemnity and the Completion Guaranty, and Guarantor's execution of an acknowledgment of this Mortgage, if any, shall not expand Guarantor's obligations hereunder.

### Section 16.3 No Merger

The lien of this Mortgage shall not merge with any other interest, estate or lien held by Lender, whether by foreclosure, deed in lieu of foreclosure, acquisition of title or otherwise, it being the intent of the parties that Lender's rights and remedies under the Loan Documents continue in full force and effect until the Obligations are indefeasibly paid and performed in full, except to the extent Lender expressly elects otherwise in writing.

## ARTICLE XVII — MISCELLANEOUS

### Section 17.1 Notices

All notices, demands, consents, approvals and other communications under this Mortgage shall be in writing and shall be deemed duly given (a) when delivered by hand (with written confirmation of receipt), (b) one (1) Business Day after deposit with a nationally recognized overnight courier, (c) three (3) Business Days after deposit in the United States mail, certified or registered, return receipt requested, postage prepaid, or (d) when sent by electronic mail in portable document format, if sent during normal business hours of the recipient and otherwise on the next Business Day, provided that the sender does not receive an automated message indicating non-delivery. Notices shall be addressed as follows:

> **If to Lender:** Calverley Heritage Bank, 412 Whitaker Street, Savannah, Georgia 31401, Attention: Marcus Prideaux, Senior Vice President — Commercial Real Estate Lending, Email: mprideaux@coastalheritagebank.com; with a copy to Fielding, Ashworth & Cole LLP, Attention: Catherine Ashworth, Partner, Email: (as designated by Lender in writing).
>
> **If to Borrower:** Palmetto Gateway Partners LLC, 88 Broad Street, Suite 200, Charleston, South Carolina 29401, Attention: Neil Ashford Graydon, Managing Member of Graydon Development Group LLC; with a copy to Cartwright & Lyons LLP, Attention: (as designated by Borrower in writing).
>
> **If to Guarantor:** Neil Ashford Graydon, 14 Church Street, Charleston, South Carolina 29401.

Any party may change its notice address by written notice given in accordance with this Section.

### Section 17.2 Governing Law; Venue

This Mortgage shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of South Carolina, without regard to principles of conflicts of law that would require the application of the laws of another jurisdiction. Any litigation arising out of or relating to this Mortgage or the other Loan Documents shall be brought in the courts of the State of South Carolina, County of Charleston, or in the United States District Court for the District of South Carolina, Charleston Division, and each party consents to the personal jurisdiction and venue of such courts.

### Section 17.3 Waiver of Jury Trial

**BORROWER AND LENDER EACH KNOWINGLY, VOLUNTARILY AND INTENTIONALLY WAIVE ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION, PROCEEDING OR COUNTERCLAIM ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS MORTGAGE, THE OTHER LOAN DOCUMENTS, THE LOAN OR THE PROPERTY.** Borrower certifies that this waiver is a material inducement to Lender's making of the Loan and that it has had the opportunity to consult with counsel regarding this waiver.

### Section 17.4 Usury Savings

Notwithstanding any other provision of the Loan Documents, no provision of the Loan Documents shall require the payment or permit the collection of interest or other charges in excess of the maximum amount permitted by applicable law. If any amount in excess of such maximum is paid or collected, such excess shall be applied to reduce the principal balance of the Loan (or, if the principal balance has been paid in full, refunded to Borrower), and the effective rate of interest shall be automatically reduced to the maximum lawful rate.

### Section 17.5 Severability

If any provision of this Mortgage is held to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable in any respect, such invalidity, illegality or unenforceability shall not affect any other provision, and this Mortgage shall be construed as if such provision had never been contained herein, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

### Section 17.6 Successors and Assigns; No Assignment by Borrower

This Mortgage shall be binding upon and shall inure to the benefit of Borrower, Lender and their respective successors and permitted assigns. Borrower may not assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations under this Mortgage except in compliance with **Section 9.2**, and any purported assignment in violation thereof shall be void. Lender may assign or participate its interest in the Loan and this Mortgage without Borrower's consent, and Borrower shall reasonably cooperate with any such assignment or participation, including by providing such information and estoppel certificates as Lender may reasonably request.

### Section 17.7 Entire Agreement; Amendment

The Loan Documents, together with the Term Sheet (to the extent not superseded by the Loan Documents), constitute the entire agreement among the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersede all prior agreements, understandings and negotiations, whether written or oral. In the event of any conflict between the terms of the Term Sheet and the terms of any Loan Document, the terms of the Loan Document shall control. No amendment, modification or waiver of any provision of this Mortgage shall be effective unless in writing and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought.

### Section 17.8 Estoppel Certificates

Within ten (10) Business Days after Lender's written request, Borrower shall deliver to Lender, or to any prospective purchaser or assignee designated by Lender, a certificate certifying (a) the outstanding principal balance of the Loan and the amount of accrued and unpaid interest, (b) whether any Event of Default exists, (c) the absence of any offsets, defenses or claims against Lender, and (d) such other matters as Lender may reasonably request.

### Section 17.9 Time of the Essence

Time is of the essence with respect to each obligation of Borrower under this Mortgage and the other Loan Documents.

### Section 17.10 No Partnership or Joint Venture

Nothing in this Mortgage shall be deemed to create a partnership, joint venture or fiduciary relationship between Lender and Borrower, or to make Lender a partner or joint venturer in Borrower's business. The relationship of Lender and Borrower is that of creditor and debtor (and mortgagee and mortgagor) only.

### Section 17.11 Recording; Expenses; Documentary Stamps

Borrower shall pay all costs and expenses of recording this Mortgage and all financing statements and amendments in the RMC Office and with the South Carolina Secretary of State, including all documentary stamp taxes, recording fees, title insurance premiums and endorsements, and all other costs of the Loan described in **Section 13.2** of the Term Sheet. The documentary stamp tax payable on this Mortgage, computed at the rate of $1.85 per $500.00 of indebtedness secured hereby on the amount of $14,750,000.00, is $54,575.00, which shall be paid at or prior to recording. Borrower shall pay such additional documentary stamp taxes as may be required in connection with any future advance or increase in the indebtedness secured hereby. Borrower's obligations under this Section shall survive the recording of this Mortgage and shall be secured hereby.

### Section 17.12 Counterparts; Electronic Signatures

This Mortgage may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart by facsimile or electronic mail (including in portable document format) shall have the same force and effect as delivery of an originally executed counterpart. Any electronic signature complying with the South Carolina Uniform Electronic Transactions Act, S.C. Code Ann. § 26-6-10 *et seq.*, shall be deemed a valid original signature; provided that, for purposes of recording, an original or notarized counterpart shall be delivered as required.

### Section 17.13 Headings; Construction

The headings in this Mortgage are for convenience of reference only and shall not affect the interpretation of any provision. The parties acknowledge that each has been represented by counsel of its choosing in the negotiation and preparation of this Mortgage.

### Section 17.14 Acknowledgment of No Fiduciary Duty

Lender's relationship to Borrower is solely that of a lender and mortgagee. Lender has no fiduciary or other special relationship with Borrower, and Borrower acknowledges that Lender has not provided any legal, tax, accounting or investment advice to Borrower in connection with the Loan.

### Section 17.15 Survival

All representations, warranties, covenants and indemnities contained in this Mortgage shall survive the closing of the Loan, the recording of this Mortgage and, except to the extent fully performed, the repayment of the Loan.

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > build/postprocess.py <<'PY'
import sys
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

path, footer_text, title, subject = sys.argv[1:5]
d = Document(path)

# ---- core properties
cp = d.core_properties
cp.title = title
cp.subject = subject
cp.author = "Fielding, Ashworth & Cole LLP"
cp.comments = "CHB CRE Loan No. 2025-CHS-0047"

# ---- table borders helper
def set_borders(tbl):
    tblPr = tbl._tbl.tblPr
    for el in tblPr.findall(qn('w:tblBorders')):
        tblPr.remove(el)
    b = OxmlElement('w:tblBorders')
    for edge in ('top','left','bottom','right','insideH','insideV'):
        e = OxmlElement(f'w:{edge}')
        e.set(qn('w:val'),'single'); e.set(qn('w:sz'),'4')
        e.set(qn('w:space'),'0'); e.set(qn('w:color'),'808080')
        b.append(e)
    tblPr.append(b)

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    sh = OxmlElement('w:shd')
    sh.set(qn('w:val'),'clear'); sh.set(qn('w:color'),'auto'); sh.set(qn('w:fill'),hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(sh)

# column width profiles (relative), applied cyclically by table size
def widths_for(ncols, total_in):
    presets = {
        2: [3.4, 3.1],
        3: [2.4, 2.1, 2.0],
        5: [1.5, 1.05, 1.05, 1.45, 1.45],
        7: [0.55, 2.05, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95],
        11: [0.85, 0.9, 0.55, 1.25, 0.65, 0.65, 0.5, 0.55, 0.5, 0.55, 0.55],
    }
    if ncols in presets:
        w = presets[ncols]
        s = sum(w)
        return [total_in * x / s for x in w]
    return [total_in / ncols] * ncols

for tbl in d.tables:
    ncols = len(tbl.columns)
    tbl.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    set_borders(tbl)
    # width
    tblPr = tbl._tbl.tblPr
    for el in tblPr.findall(qn('w:tblW')):
        tblPr.remove(el)
    tw = OxmlElement('w:tblW'); tw.set(qn('w:type'),'dxa'); tw.set(qn('w:w'), str(int(6.5*1440)))
    tblPr.append(tw)
    ws = widths_for(ncols, 6.5)
    for row in tbl.rows:
        for i, cell in enumerate(row.cells):
            if i < len(ws):
                cell.width = Inches(ws[i])
    for i, col in enumerate(tbl.columns):
        if i < len(ws):
            col.width = Inches(ws[i])
    # header formatting
    hdr = tbl.rows[0]
    # repeat header
    trPr = hdr._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    if trPr.find(qn('w:tblHeader')) is None:
        th = OxmlElement('w:tblHeader'); trPr.append(th)
    for cell in hdr.cells:
        shade(cell, 'E8E8E8')
        for p in cell.paragraphs:
            for r in p.runs:
                r.font.bold = True
    # font sizing
    for row in tbl.rows:
        for cell in row.cells:
            for p in cell.paragraphs:
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(1)
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
                p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.0
                for r in p.runs:
                    r.font.size = Pt(8.5)

# ---- footer: identifier line above page numbers
for s in d.sections:
    f = s.footer
    p0 = f.paragraphs[0]
    newp = f.add_paragraph()
    # move new paragraph above paragraph 0
    p0._p.addprevious(newp._p)
    newp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run = newp.add_run(footer_text)
    run.font.size = Pt(7.5)
    run.font.name = 'Times New Roman'
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x59,0x59,0x59)
    newp.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
    newp.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)

d.save(path)
print("postprocessed", path)
PY
echo ok"}
